# RtMidi 6.0.0

Unmodified `RtMidi.h`, `RtMidi.cpp` and `LICENSE` from https://github.com/thestk/rtmidi (tag 6.0.0),
MIT-style licence. Feedra uses it for MIDI input: ALSA on Linux, CoreMIDI on macOS, WinMM on
Windows. Built as a small static library by the top-level CMakeLists.txt (`FEEDRA_WITH_MIDI`).
